rows.note: Use 再 as the all-purpose choice for repeating an action, and also for an added amount or an explicitly renewed thanks.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 zoi3 king1 laa1

rows.note: Use 又 when applying a previous point to another case or saying that something is also true.

example.english: He has to go to work, and I have to go to work again as well.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jiu3 faan1 gung1 ngo5 jau6 jiu3 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use V + 番 when an action restores something to a former state or place, rather than merely repeating it.

example.english: Put the book back on the shelf again.
example.jyutping: nei5 fong3 faan1 bun2 syu1 hai2 gaa3 soeng6 min6

rows.note: Use 仲有 to introduce an additional point in the sense of “besides” or “moreover.”

example.english: Besides, we have to hand in the homework again today.
example.traditional: 仲有，今日要再交一次功課。
example.jyutping: zung6 jau5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zoi3 gaau1 jat1 ci3 gung1 fo3
